Hi Nina — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: reduce clinician triage time in the triage portal by surfacing concise differential suggestions and confidence bands.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in triage time for flagged cases; maintain >=92% acceptable accuracy on benchmark prompts.
- Primary stakeholders: Nina (Clinical Ops), Alex (Integration lead), Procurement (contract/MPA).

Proposed next steps
1) Schedule a 60-min evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan walkthrough + prompt handoff).
2) Share a small prompt sample and trial rubric we can use to set baselines.
3) Draft MPA for legal/procurement review so infra access and data residency are covered.

Availability windows (PST) — please pick one that works for you or propose alternatives:
- Tue Nov 24 — 10:00–11:30 OR 14:00–15:00
- Wed Nov 25 — 09:00–11:00
- Mon Nov 30 — 13:00–15:00

Ben (SE) will lead the technical deep dive and Laura (AM) will cover success metrics and mutual action plan. I attached a short prompt sample and an initial MPA draft for procurement to review (GWH-MPA-draft-v1.pdf, gwh_prompt_samples.csv).

If those windows don't work, we can open up more times next week. Also: is there any legal/IT reviewer we should loop in besides procurement?

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time and getting the prompt pack into your hands.

— Priyom
